title: Listen and Choose a Response — At the Gym

questions.stem: We're offering a free week for anyone who signs up today.

options.A: I signed my name on the form yesterday.
options.B: I'd like to try it, but can I cancel anytime?
options.D: Yes, I was free last weekend.
